title: 🔍 US Intelligence Chief Confirms: China Obtained Advanced Nvidia AI Chips!
body: 🔍 US Intelligence Chief Confirms: China Obtained Advanced Nvidia AI Chips!
The US Director of National Intelligence has confirmed that China obtained advanced AI chips from Nvidia, despite US export restrictions that ban selling these chips to it.
The confirmation came in a television interview on 22 November, in which the director said that, based on what was in the indictment, there had indeed been access to those chips.
The director did not specify the types of chips, their quantities, who received them, or the methods used to smuggle them, simply confirming that the access had taken place.

The case comes in the context of an indictment issued in March against three people accused of diverting American servers carrying advanced AI technology to China, and authorities confirmed on 17 November that they are investigating a Singapore-based company suspected of playing a role in the same network.

Nvidia's CEO is scheduled to testify before Congress on 1 December, while the investigation into the case continues, at a time when US export restrictions aim to slow China's progress in artificial intelligence.
Simply put: despite the US ban, advanced Nvidia chips reached China... so do export restrictions actually succeed in stopping technology from getting through?
Do you think chip smuggling will continue no matter how strict the restrictions get?
